prerequisites: Basic mathematics from analysis, algebra, statistics, and data science courses.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply machine learning techniques to diverse sensor signals (e.g., image, audio, time series, …).
Collect data appropriately, prepare signals, select suitable models considering constraints such as available data, memory, and computational power, and train and use these models.
Be aware of the possibilities and limitations of machine learning.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Terminology, Artificial Intelligence vs. Machine Learning, needs in signal processing, model-based vs. data-driven methods, pattern recognition
Model-based methods; Bayesian inference: maximum likelihood estimation vs. maximum a posteriori estimator
Linear methods: recap linear regression; preprocessing and feature extraction
Neural networks: terminology, perceptron, multilayer perceptron
Training a neural network: loss functions, hyperparameters, stochastic gradient descent
Networks with dense outputs, Reinforcement learning
Reflection: Trends and limitations of machine learning-based methods
Training a model, selection of hyperparameters

assessment_methods.method: Written exam during the examination period with open questions

institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
